title: Ajisai hand-written outcome witnesses
description: Programs that reach an outcome ID (spec/outcomes.json) docs/semantics-table.json cannot, because it only ever runs one Word against one input-domain tuple (docs/dev/outcome-space-bijection-work-order-2026-09.md Phase 4 pitfall A). Three shapes need this file: an outcome reachable only through a multi-statement program (a name conflict, a self-reference, a dependency lock), one that depends on a runtime resource ceiling rather than an input shape, and one no chosen domain representative happens to trigger. scripts/check-outcome-bijection.mjs is the only reader: it runs every entry's source through the real `ajisai` CLI and fails the ID if the observed outcome does not match `expect` exactly. A witness that is only checked by string-matching its source, never executed, is not a witness (Phase 2 pitfall B) — this file supplies the *inputs* to that execution, nothing more.

id.description: An id from spec/outcomes.json's nilReasons or errorCategories. Non-vacuity (Phase 4) accepts a witness here in place of a docs/semantics-table.json cell for this same id — an id present in both is not an error, but a witness never substitutes for fixing a table that could reach the id more cheaply.

source.description: Ajisai source text, run verbatim through `ajisai run <file> --json` (with --step-limit appended when profile.stepLimit is set). Must be the actual program that reaches the outcome — the gate re-runs it every time, it does not trust this field's history.

profile.description: A non-default runtime ceiling this witness needs to reach its outcome (docs/dev/mcp-host-profiles.md). Omit entirely for a witness that reaches its outcome under the native CLI's own built-in defaults — most witnesses in this file do.

stepLimit.description: Passed to `ajisai run` as `--step-limit`, the one ceiling the CLI exposes an override for. A witness for executionLimitExceeded needs this; every other resourceLimitExceeded/materializedElements-family witness in this registry reaches its ceiling by construction instead (an oversized literal, a call chain past the fixed recursion depth) because no other ceiling has a CLI override to shrink it.

expect.description: The classification scripts/generate-semantics-table.mjs's classifyOutcome would assign this program's `ajisai run --json` output: `value`, `nil:<reason>`, or `error:<category>`, in the exact same spelling docs/semantics-table.json's own `outcome` field uses. The gate re-derives this from the live CLI run and compares it verbatim — never from message text (LANG-stable identifiers only, per this work order's §0.3).

rationale.description: Why docs/semantics-table.json cannot reach this id on its own: which of Phase 4 pitfall A's three shapes applies (multi-statement, resource-ceiling-dependent, or no domain representative triggers it) and, briefly, what this program does that a single (Word, domain tuple) cell cannot. Required so a reviewer can tell a genuine gap from a witness that should have been a domain addition instead.
